normal.name: Jenny Cosplay 🏳️‍⚧️🎮
normal.text: Lit going from WiiWare to PC is still by far the biggest visual downgrade I have ever seen. Like, who the hell thought this was a good idea? Apparently the PC version is a port of the iOS version, but whyyyyyyyyyyyyy?? All the atmosphere in this horror(!) puzzle game is completely gone. This port is almost a decade old but it still baffles me. A shame, especially since Lit was well received on WiiWare and is now officially unobtainable. #wii #wiiware #gaming #pcgaming #retrogaming
normal.media: 2 images: Screenshot of Lit on Wii. It's a top down horror game with a realistic art style, showing a teen in a pitch black dark classroom with crossing beams of light f… / Screenshot of Lit on Steam, an overtly cartoony and bright recreation, to the point that apart from the gameplay setup it's almost unrecognisable.

normal.name: schamspeare
normal.text: After a couple days of play, I think i'm getting a bit better at #MTG. But I'll tell you something: the game has a way of making you feel you're screwed. Like, there have been numerous times already where I wanted to resign after turn two. But I kept slogging, sometimes for a full half hour, telling myself to just learn the game, and have eventually won with, say, one health left. It can feel tedious and, weirdly, kind of crushing, even if you go on to win. #magicthegathering #mtgarena #games
